description: Calculate projected daily and billing cycle Compute Units (CU) and USD costs for planned call volumes across one or more methods, factoring in method weights and free credit allowances from /v1/plans. Also evaluates whether traffic requires multiple API keys under key_defaults. Use this tool for volume budget calculations and capacity planning. For looking up raw system pricing tables, use get_pricing instead. For checking whether a single method is supported on a specific chain, use get_method_info instead. Accepts 'lines' array of {method, calls_per_day} or single 'method' and 'calls_per_day'.

calls_per_day.description: Expected daily call volume (non-negative integer). Single-method mode.

lines.description: List of methods and daily call volumes to estimate.

name: estimate_usage
title: Estimate Usage and Cost
